name: marker
summary: A program for marking student essays using local AI: one or several local Ollama models (default gpt-oss:20b) mark against an analytic, criterion-referenced rubric, as a reproducible second marker with per-criterion justifications, verified evidence quotes, feedback, review flags and provenance.
principles: Security and privacy of student data first: essays never leave the machine; the Ollama host must be loopback unless --allow-remote.
Reproducibility: seeds seed+i, retries seed+1000*attempt, a fingerprint of every input, model digests and versions in provenance.
Marking validity: criterion-referenced bands, median of independent samples, the model never does arithmetic, review flags for humans.

marks.internal: Fractions 0.0-1.0. Python float by default; exact Decimal with 4 places with --numeric decimal.
marks.score: score = score_min + weighted_mark * (score_max - score_min), rounded half up to --score-places. Default 0-100 integers.
marks.display: Terminal displays of 0-1 fractions are whole percents rounded half to even on the exact decimal value (0.135 -> 14%).
marks.bands: UK classification bands from the rubric; a mark belongs to the highest band whose minimum is at or below it.

context_window.behaviour: Essays whose prompt may not fit are refused before marking; a prompt that filled the window fails; prompt+answer overflow is retried.

outputs.<out>/<essay-id>.json: Full result: mark, weighted_mark, score, band, needs_review, flags, criteria, feedback, integrity_concerns, samples, provenance.
outputs.<out>/summary.csv: One row per essay: id, score, score_min, score_max, mark, band, needs_review, one column per criterion, word_count, flags, model, model_digest.
outputs.<out>/audit.jsonl: Append-only log, one line per marking event (marked or reanalysed).
outputs.<out>/comparison.csv, comparison.json: With several models: per-model marks, scores and bands, spread, panel mark and score, agreement, notes; pairwise statistics in the JSON.
outputs.multi-model layout: With several models, each model's results go to <out>/<model-slug>/.

review_flags: <criterion>: <n> evidence quote(s) not found in the essay
borderline: <mark%> is within <margin%> below the <boundary%> boundary
word count <n> is below the minimum <min>
model gave marks outside its chosen band (clamped)
